newsitem.title: GERMANY: Preussag says sees good outlook this year.
newsitem.headline: Preussag says sees good outlook this year.

text.p: Michael Frenzel, management board chairman of German diversified engineering group Preussag AG said on Thursday he sees a good outlook for the current business year.
"The outlook for the current business year is good," Frenzel said in remarks prepared for delivery at the company's annual news conference.

"The strategic targets for the company are clearly defined. Restructuring programmes to improve results are under way. The economic environment has improved since the start of this fiscal year. Overall, Preussag expects a high quality result for 1996/97."
For the year ended September 30, Preussag reported a decline in net profit to 274 million marks from 349 million the year before, as sales fell to 25.044 billion marks from 26.353 billion marks.
-- Terence Gallagher, Bonn Newsroom, 49 228 26097150 ($ = 1.65 German Marks)
